Yudi

Not sure whether you were using Distance for Windows or the R package Distance.  Both sets of software produce point estimates of density along with upper and lower confidence interval bounds.  You will want those three quantities to create each bar.

There are a host of ways to create bar plots with error bars in R.  One web site describing how to create such plots can be found at

https://www.r-graph-gallery.com/4-barplot-with-error-bar.html
